scope: Synthetic capabilities and owned-asset facts only; no model invocation or production project writes

examples: Enum member outside the numeric maximum
rules.boundary: Project native UI caches out before validating Router parameters. Unsupported schema assertions fail explicitly; backend remains authoritative.

examples: Image dimensions missing while maxPixels is declared
File size missing while maxBytes is declared
Audio total duration above declared aggregate maximum
Catalog-declared upstream output dimensions exceed downstream limits before batch submission
rules.boundary: The common execution preparation invokes these helpers for every resolved capability. Actual consumed asset metadata is trusted; planned outputs use only matching catalog-declared known facts and never invent missing metadata. Browser display metadata is not trusted asset evidence.

examples: Real model IMAGE_TO_IMAGE without an image
Image edit feature template without its required reference
rules.boundary: Legacy generic mock IMAGE_TO_IMAGE is not given stronger requirements. Template-specific requirements remain distinct from model modality compatibility.

examples: First-last frame needs exactly two images
Advertised per-kind and total reference maxima
rules.boundary: Versioned x-media-roles and x-media-limits define profile requirements; unadvertised provider restrictions are not guessed.

examples: Any full-graph cycle including unselected nodes
rules.boundary: App-only topological sorting is insufficient for ordinary canvas/group submission. Frozen command projection may intentionally contain only the target and consumed dependencies.
Form revisions and asset access can change after local validation, and must still be checked by the server.

examples: Invalid trim, crop, speed, rotate or mirror
Incompatible output dimensions, codecs or container
rules.boundary: The frontend should mirror syntax and declared input metadata constraints. Actual decoding, corrupt streams, FFmpeg availability and output verification remain runtime concerns.

examples: Upstream planned result has not been produced yet
Model rejects or returns corrupt output
rules.boundary: Never fabricate metadata, silently replace selected history, or weaken server authorization and consistency checks to make preflight appear complete.

parameterSchemaSupport.limits: Bounded schema and value recursion; no silent success for unknown assertions
